descriptionChirho: Water flowing in streams, wadis, or rivers; includes the substantivized participle used as 'streams' and verbal forms describing the natural movement of water along a course.
Rain or moisture pouring down from the skies or heavens, emphasizing the downward cascading of water from above rather than horizontal flow along the ground.
A gentle dripping or distilling, often used figuratively of speech, honey, or myrrh slowly dropping, as distinct from the full flow of a stream.
Causative stem indicating making water flow, as when God caused streams to flow from the rock in the wilderness.
